column1: # Lithuanian (lt) catalog for the whole CFA4 interface (Qt GUI and egui). Same format as es.tsv:
# context <TAB> source <TAB> translation.
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label using ordinary
# Lithuanian video-editing vocabulary (laiko juosta, takelis, klipas, seka, aplankas, atkūrimo
# žymeklis, žymė, perėjimas, pagrindinis kadras). No proprietary localisation resource, string
# table or product UI was consulted or copied; add entries the same way. Commands are infinitives
# ("Įrašyti kaip…"), labels use sentence case, quotation marks are „…“, and product and format
# names (CFA4, Lumetri, ProRes, AAF, EDL…) keep their spelling. Decimal comma (0,5). A
# native-speaker review is welcome.
# Terms: clip = klipas, track = takelis, sequence = seka, timeline = laiko juosta, bin = aplankas,
# playhead = atkūrimo žymeklis, marker = žymė, In/Out point = pradžios/pabaigos taškas, keyframe =
# pagrindinis kadras, caption = subtitrai, preset = išankstinė nuostata, template = šablonas,
# workspace = darbo sritis, gain = stiprinimas, opacity = nepermatomumas, render = atvaizdavimas,
# ripple = su poslinkiu, dissolve = išnykimas, wipe = nušluostymas, voice-over = užkadrinis balsas,
# proxy = tarpinė kopija, guide = kreipiamoji linija, shortcut = spartusis klavišas,
# (Legacy) = (senasis).
# Licence: GPL-3.0-or-later (CFA4 contributors), except the section imported from craft-i18n at
# the end (MIT OR Apache-2.0); see lt.tsv.attribution.
